local_conclusions: UCE reconstructs the full original local ordinary-point and coefficient-algebra path. It proves ordered-flag specialization in every allowed characteristic, integral triangularization and all five OrdPt fields. Actual entry coordinates give the integral weighted presentation; finite monomial arguments and characteristic-prime DVR curves prove the complete FinCrit without reducedness or coefficient-flatness assumptions. Finite-index characteristic polynomials force constant diagonal entries and a single triangular orientation, including the permitted abstract characteristic-three case; the original final GD.gen guard ell-1 not dividing2e itself excludes ell=3. Finite weight zero then controls arbitrary entry-algebra maps through finite homogeneous modules, rather than presuming their continuity. Every point has an actual finite-coefficient ordinary torus conjugate, and TypeI is irreducible on every required open subgroup. Conjugacy transports both exact automorphic conclusions and every outer-corner extension at the same fixed iota. Thus one common GdEnd supplies FinA, AutB and LemW for one shared g1. GdEnd itself, the common abelian-CM frame, both seeds and full PfromAut/ModUAlt remain explicit; AUT_UNRAM_COEF is not closed.

BWP reconstructs the actual local wave packet and its normalized global product. An explicit polynomial chart on the original unipotent group has Haar Jacobian one and yields the exact integrable norm exponent. Harish-Chandra admissibility and a finite-dimensional convolution-polynomial argument give the full compact reproducer in any prescribed identity neighborhood. The original cubic GapBig dominates every required decay exponent and proves the whole CoefWeightedLoc for every supplied discrete series and lowest unit vector. The packet is continuous, equivariant, has the printed weighted quotient L1 and L2 bounds, and is reproduced by the exact formal-degree kernel and a compact kernel. The retained BesselNVGap gives precisely its nonzero norm, so the original WlocExists is complete on its original antecedents. Correct transport uses two group conjugacies and one equivariant torsor map, preserves the character factor4*pi/g_D and every supplied measure, and gives WFromLoc plus WExists conditional on BesselNVGap. The global vector is chosen before every later measured block and satisfies its decay. With inherited Forms0 setting blocks this gives ConcreteSettingExists in their original scope. BesselNVGap, multiplicity-one and the later orbital/Siegel-Weil comparisons remain separate.

HUF supplies the whole original finite holomorphic FamilyUnif and N1c on the given Moduli record. It extracts the actual exponential kernel, integral CM datum and all-level Tate/genus comparisons from every moduli point; constructs relative exponentials and full continued lattices; and proves the prescribed local lift on one neighborhood with every positive Weil level. Period kernel coordinates and marked uniqueness prove holomorphy even for arbitrary pointwise choices of points and exponentials. Finitely many analytic components give one finite positive family chosen before all periods and bases, without compactness of the moduli space. Explicit primitive semicharacters give fixed half characteristics and theta factors. Proper analytic base change and the zero rigidification provide the global normalized theta-line isomorphism; projective GAGA supplies the algebraic section on each fiber. Every FamilyUnif and IsThetaFrame clause, exact negative Weil sign, both markings, dimension-zero case and universal choice order is retained. The representing Moduli itself, principal framed points, IsUnf, reduced-test FromTest and later theta spanning remain adjoining producers.

WRS supplies the full uniform local-gain selected obligation. The complete local/Taylor kernel and comparison record survives division on arbitrary original submodules, and one map on the dependent joint tuple preserves the actual geometric kernel. Membership in the original built class already identifies the given point and Extra data with a joint constructed witness. The completed LGS13 implication therefore gives all five original LinkG_at fields with CG=4*Ccount+1 and delta(x)=x^(-epsilon/2), chosen before all later actual indices.
